messages:
ops-alert-bot: Paging: High token accounting delta for tenant 'thorium' in VPC-dedicated pool eu-west-2. Token meter spiking vs baseline, possible tokenizer/encoding mismatch. Alert: billing_rate > 5x usual for last 15m. priority: high
emma: on it. seeing same in dashboards; per-route token_count surges for model 'llama-3-13b-redwood'.
raj: tagging in — thorium runs a custom ingestion pipeline that sometimes injects non-utf8 chars. suspect encoding fallback changed after the vpc ingress proxy upgrade last week.
lina: support pinged customer (Thorium) — they report increased costs but no functional errors. they're anxious about billing.
harry: customer-facing: i'll tell them we've isolated the issue and are applying mitigations. do not promise credits until we confirm cause.
oncall-sre: I'm taking the incident. @emma @raj confirm if this is isolated to thorium or seen across tenants in that pool.
emma: looks tenant-specific: other tenants in same pool steady. tokenization distribution skewed: median token size doubled for thorium requests.
raj: pulled a sample of raw payloads from thorium traces. noticed stray 0xC2 bytes and a mix of latin1 payloads. tokenizer (sentencepiece) on our side treats these as two-codepoint sequences increasing token count.
mike: is the ingress proxy supposed to normalize charset to utf-8? last deploy notes said we enabled 'preserve-raw-headers' flag. could be related.
emma: deploy-bot: last ingress change 3/04 set preserve-raw-headers=true on vpc-proxy-thorium.
deploy-bot: deploy recorded: ingress-proxy v3.12.1 -> v3.13.0 for tenant thorium at 2026-03-14T02:03Z.
oncall-sre: mitigation plan: 1) route thorium traffic to isolated fallback queue with conservative billing cap, 2) temporary token normalization (silently re-encode latin1->utf8) at proxy layer, 3) run token recompute and adjust billing anomaly. anyone object?
emma: agree. we should also enable KV cache bypass to avoid false cache key explosion.
raj: I can push a hotfix to the tokenizer wrapper that normalizes input encoding and collapses suspicious control sequences before tokenization. quick patch ready.
lina: support: i've told customer we have a mitigation that will reduce their immediate billing spike. they asked for ETA ~30m.
harry: i'll offer a temporary bill hold if we confirm upstream issue. need engineering confirmation before credit.
emma: action: moving thorium to isolated serving lane now. exec: `rwdctl route set --tenant thorium --pool isolated-safemode --reason encoding-spike`
raj: applying tokenizer wrapper patch to isolated lane. patch diff: ```diff
- tokens = tokenizer.tokenize(text)
+ text = text.encode('latin-1').decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
+ tokens = tokenizer.tokenize(text)
```
emma: note: using errors='replace' will insert replacement chars which can slightly change output; we'll use this only for token accounting path, not for model prompt content (we'll preserve raw input for inference path).
oncall-sre: please confirm separation: accounting vs inference content. we must avoid changing model outputs.
raj: confirmed. accounting step runs on a copy of the payload before model input. production patch only updates accounting/token counter. inference path unchanged.
mike: enabling request-level billing cap: `billingctl set-limit --tenant thorium --rate 2x-baseline --duration 2h`
docs: log snippet from token_counter service (sanitized): ```
[2026-03-15T08:02:11Z] tenant=thorium request_id=abc123 raw_len=1243 token_count_pre=4315 token_count_post=212 encoding_detect=latin1
[2026-03-15T08:02:12Z] tenant=thorium request_id=abc124 raw_len=1243 token_count_pre=4320 token_count_after_fix=215
```
emma: after the accounting normalization, token counts drop to expected range (~200 tokens). Good sign.
oncall-sre: temporary mitigation seems effective. next steps: 1) keep thorium isolated for 2h, 2) run broader scan for other tenants that might have latin1 payloads, 3) prepare permanent ingress proxy patch to normalize encodings safely, 4) billing reconciliation and potential credits.
lina: thorium support says they will audit their upstream data. they confirmed some older connectors might emit latin1.
harry: customer update: emailed Thorium that we've applied a protective fix and are investigating root cause; asked for logs they can share.
emma: scoping broader scan now: running query `select tenant, count(*) from token_counter where encoding_detect='latin1' and timestamp > now()-24h group by tenant order by count desc limit 20`
raj: early results: only thorium shows >100 events; a few other tenants have single-digit occurrences.
mike: can we schedule an ingress proxy revert for preserve-raw-headers flag? I'd rather normalize inbound always but need to verify no regressions.
emma: we'll roll a canary: proxy v3.13.1 with auto-normalize enabled for a small sample of tenants. patch to accounting-only first.
oncall-sre: communication: ops slack stub: incident severity = high (customer billing and potential SLA questions). page on-call manager.
emma: oncall manager (simon) paged.
simon: confirmed. please file incident postmortem and prepare recommended credits if root cause is ours.
raj: root cause hypothesis: proxy upgrade toggled header/body handling exposing latin1 bytes to our token counter. token counter previously did a utf-8 coercion; change removed it. patch and config revert will resolve.
lina: thorium asked about immediate credit. recommend we wait for final accounting recalculation. can we run a retroactive token recompute for last 12 hours?
emma: re-compute possible but heavy. estimate 4-6h job on dedicated worker cluster. prioritize last 2h for now to reduce billing pain.
oncall-sre: action items assigned: emma -> confirm recompute window and execution plan; raj -> land tokenizer accounting patch and ingress canary; mike -> revert flag for thorium or enable normalization; lina/harry -> hold customer update and prepare credits docs.
emma: started recompute job for last 2h. tracking id: recompute-thorium-1844201123-1. logs will be in /var/logs/recompute/1844201123.log
raj: tokenizer accounting patch pushed to isolated lane; will promote to canary after 30m verification.
emma: verification looks clean: token metrics stable for 10m after patch.
oncall-sre: timeline update: 08:05 incident detected -> 08:12 mitigation routing applied -> 08:20 tokenizer accounting patch -> 08:50 recompute for 2h started -> 09:30 recompute complete for 2h window with accounting adjustments queued.
harry: customer emailed with friendly update and ETA for billing reconciliation. they asked if we can expedite credits — sales/rev ops looped.
mike: long-term fix: update ingress proxy to ensure charset normalization and add unit tests for mixed-encoding payloads. I'll open RFC and assign owners.
simon: good work. please capture root cause and timeline in postmortem template. severity will be Major 2.
oncall-sre: closing notes: keep thorium isolated another hour, after full recompute we'll reconcile billing and follow up with customer. if any regressions surface, re-open thread. :white_check_mark:
